name: Zelevation Custom Box Builder for WooCommerce
author: zelevation

sections.description:
🚀 Live Demo

Zelevation Custom Box Builder is a powerful WooCommerce extension designed to help store owners increase average order value (AOV) by allowing customers to build their own custom product boxes, gift sets, or cosmetic kits.

With a modern, responsive, quiz-style step-by-step layout, customers are guided through a sleek selection process. Perfect for cosmetics, gift boxes, meal kits, custom packs, and subscription boxes.

Features

  • Step-by-Step Box Builder: Guide customers through selection steps (e.g. Step 1: Choose Cleanser, Step 2: Choose Makeup).
  • Flat Rate or Dynamic Pricing: Charge a fixed price for the entire box or calculate the price dynamically based on selected items.
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions Compatibility: Allow customers to subscribe to their custom boxes (requires WooCommerce Subscriptions).
  • Elegant Visual Sidebar: Real-time visual slots matching selected items and real-time box price summary.
  • AJAX Add to Cart & Shipping: Fast, seamless user experience without page reloads.
  • Fully Responsive: Beautifully adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Custom Step Limits: Set minimum and maximum selection constraints for each step.

✉️ Request Customization & Custom Development
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire zelevation-custom-box-builder-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to any WooCommerce Product page, select the Custom Box Builder tab, enable the builder, and configure your steps.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, WooCommerce Custom Box Builder fully supports variable products. If you select a variable product for a step, it will automatically list its individual variations as choices.

Does it support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes! If you enable subscriptions, it integrates natively with the official WooCommerce Subscriptions extension.

Can I use it with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the plugin enqueues modern styles designed to work with all major themes (including Astra, Divi, OceanWP, and default WooCommerce themes).
